title: SSO authz fallback and audit-trail rectification: post-incident action items
creator: Morgan Li
description: Follow-up work from the 2026-02-27 SSO outage that coincided with a partial audit logging gap. This ticket tracks remediation, compliance steps, and long-term fixes to prevent recurrence. The incident resulted from a premature key rotation handshake combined with an unrelated log-forwarder schema regression that dropped events under backpressure.
impact_summary: Affected hosted API and Console login flows for select enterprise customers for ~27 minutes; internal audit stream lost ~18 minutes of events for several services. No data exfiltration detected. Regulatory exposure: temporary audit gap for customers with strict retention/audit requirements.
timeline: 2026-02-27 09:14 UTC - Scheduled key-rotation job started for service-auth signing keys.
2026-02-27 09:19 UTC - Upstream IdP began rejecting new tokens; increased 401s observed across Console and API gateways.
2026-02-27 09:24 UTC - Oncall route engaged fallback auth handler; automated fallback caused auth paths to bypass new audit tagging in the forwarder.
2026-02-27 09:41 UTC - Incident declared; Rotation job manually paused; hotfix deployed to accept previous key for 1 hour.
2026-02-27 09:45 UTC - Observed audit-forwarder errors: schema mismatch during recent deployment causing event drops under high load.
2026-02-27 09:56 UTC - Hotfix for forwarder deployed; ingestion backlog replay started from buffer snapshots.
2026-02-27 10:11 UTC - Majority of auth paths restored; post-incident verification and customer notifications initiated.
root_cause: Two interacting failures: (1) The automated key-rotation workflow published a new signing key before the idP metadata handshake and validation window completed, causing token validation failures at the provider. (2) A recent log-forwarder change introduced a non-backwards-compatible schema validation that caused event drops when the ingestion pipeline experienced a short burst of backpressure. The combination created a window where auth events were not recorded.
mitigations: Immediate: paused the rotation job and re-enabled acceptance of previous signing key for 1 hour; deployed forwarder schema fix and replayed buffered events from S3 snapshots.
Short-term: add alerting on audit-event ingestion rate deviation (>5 minutes) and token-validation error spike thresholds; require manual approval for production key push for next 30 days.

Long-term: implement two-phase key rotation (pre-publish + confirmation handshake), make forwarder schema strictly additive with compatibility guards, and build an automated audit replay utility with per-tenant reconciliation reports.
action_items: AI-9917-1: Implement two-phase key rotation protocol with pre-publish and confirm handshake; add canary rollout for keys - owner:Ravi Shah - due:2026-03-20 - estimate:3
AI-9917-2: Hard-fail prevention: extend key acceptance window on IdP integration to accept old key for configurable grace period - owner:Elena Gomez - due:2026-03-12 - estimate:2
AI-9917-3: Reprocess dropped audit events from archived buffers and produce reconciliation report per-customer - owner:Priya Menon - due:2026-03-15 - estimate:3
AI-9917-4: Add ingestion SLI/SLOs for audit pipeline and create PagerDuty alerts if ingestion lag >5 minutes or drop rate >0.1% - owner:Samir Patel - due:2026-03-10 - estimate:2
AI-9917-5: Add pre-merge CI checks that validate forwarder schema compatibility and run a synthetic high-throughput ingestion test in CI - owner:Mira Lopez - due:2026-04-01 - estimate:5

AI-9917-6: Update runbook and oncall playbook with explicit steps for key-rotation pause/rollback and audit replay procedures; run tabletop exercise with SRE/SEC - owner:Morgan Li - due:2026-03-18 - estimate:2
notes: Compliance/Legal alerted; legal requested per-customer disclosure notices for impacted customers with high compliance needs.
We observed no evidence of token misuse; audit replay restored 92% of missing events; remaining gaps are under targeted review.
Security review required before merging the long-term key-rotation automation (security_review_required set true).
Recommend dedicating a small taskforce (SRE + SecEng + Product) to own completion and verification of action items until closed.
